priority_why: served Value_sold/Quantity_sold in 2011-12/2013-14/2015-16 is a field-crop series; fruit/root/perennial sale prices rest on 1-3 enumerator-exception rows and are untrustworthy, with no signal.
summary: Claim holds for W1-W3: every Ethiopia/*/_/crop_production.py reads sect11_ph_w{1..5} for sales (2015-16:25-26 etc.) and none reads sect12; sect12_ph_w{1,2,3}.dta.dvc exist only for 2011-12/2013-14/2015-16. Warm Value_sold counts: 2011-12 3,497 / 2013-14 5,676 / 2015-16 4,780 / 2018-19 5,746 / 2021-22 4,019; CONTENTS.org:1519-1542 measures §12 W3 at 2,627 positive sales vs §11's 1,984 and 25 crop codes absent from §11. The sale join in ethiopia.crop_production_for_wave is keyed on (hhid, holder_id, crop_code) with Quantity_sold attached only where the sale unit equals the harvest u (2015-16 docstring) -- §12 rows must follow the same rule.
evidence: grep -n 'sect12|sect11' lsms_library/countries/Ethiopia/*/_/crop_production.py; find Ethiopia -name 'sect12_ph*'; Ethiopia/_/CONTENTS.org:1519-1545,1698-1706; warm parquet Ethiopia/var/crop_production.parquet groupby t; Ethiopia/2015-16/_/crop_production.py:1-45
approach: Step 1: read sect12_ph_w{1,2,3} variable names (W3: ph_s12q07 qty sold, ph_s12q08 value) and confirm the harvest side (§9 or §12's own harvest question) and whether §12 crops already appear in §9 harvest rows (otherwise a §12 sale has no harvest row to attach to and the same hh-crop-grain question as Nigeria #843 arises). Step 2: let ethiopia.crop_production_for_wave accept a second sale frame (`sale2`, `colmap2`) and concat it before the sale join, mapping codes through harmonize_crop; wire in the three wave scripts. Step 3: a crop-code comparison of W4/W5 §11 against the pre-2018 §11 header to confirm the fold.
verify: cold build Ethiopia crop_production; Value_sold count per t before/after (W3 expected ~4,780 -> ~7,400); untouched columns byte-identical for rows that existed; tests/test_ethiopia_shipped_factors.py, tests/test_crop_kg_factor.py, tests/test_863_transforms.py; re-run slurm_logs/price_sources/Ethiopia/analysis.py. CACHE COST: ethiopia.py -> full Ethiopia re-warm (19 script-path tables); wave scripts -> their wave only.
contents_org: Ethiopia/_/CONTENTS.org:1519-1542: §11 is headed 'CROP DISPOSITION EXCLUDE TREE/FRUIT/VEGETABLE/ROOT CROPS'; §12 Q7/Q8 are qty/value sold; :1698-1706: ESS4/ESS5 folded §12 into §11, so the gap is W1-W3 only. Also :1510-1517: ESS asks value only for purchases (§5A Q4), so food_prices(units='unitprice') empty is not-asked.
blocked_by: step 1 (the §12 harvest-row question); overlaps the landed #852 on the same scripts

title: EthiopiaRHS TLU is on a different scale than the library's: implied 0.83 per adult bovine vs _TLU_FACTORS 0.70 -- and the comment asserting 'LSU = TLU' was never verified
dedup_status: partial (the factor table is recovered and documented: 1999/_/data_info.yml:170-190 states cattle .83 / sheep,goats .20 / horses,mules,camels 1.00 vs the library's .70/.10/.80/none; 1990988e4 / #738 established the files are 1989 data; nothing served changed: data_scheme.yml:71 still declares `TLU: float # Livestock Standard Units (tropical livestock units)` and transformations.py:4849-4860 still has no mule/camel factor)
priority_why: Feature('livestock') pools an EthiopiaRHS TLU at 0.83/0.20 beside roster-country TLUs at 0.70/0.10 with no signal; and the 1999-served column is 1989 data (documented, unadjudicated).
summary: Open on two axes. (1) Convention: the served `TLU` for t=1999 is IFPRI's lsu80 (cattle .83, small ruminants .20, equines/camels 1.00), 19-100% off the library convention; for 2004 (lsu6) and 2009 (tlu7) the scale is unknown (no roster). Warm means: 1999 5.42 / 2004 2.88 / 2009 5.09 (n 541 / 1,355 / 1,577). (2) Wave: the *lvs5.tab files are 1989 data served at t='1999' (data_scheme.yml:58-62 'pending adjudication'). Library-side, transformations.tlu() maps mules/camels to NaN and drops them (issue comment), which is a separate silent-zero in every roster country with those species.
evidence: lsms_library/countries/EthiopiaRHS/_/data_scheme.yml:58-71; EthiopiaRHS/1999/_/data_info.yml:170-192; EthiopiaRHS/_/CONTENTS.org:83-152; lsms_library/transformations.py:4849-4860; warm parquet EthiopiaRHS/var/livestock.parquet groupby t; .coder/coverage/latest.csv EthiopiaRHS,livestock,1999 sane
approach: n/a: human decision -- (a) adjudicate the wave label (serve the *lvs5 files at t='1989', which also lets the 1989 (t,i,animal) roster be built per #738's proposal and the library's own tlu() applied); (b) decide whether EthiopiaRHS's pre-aggregated TLU for 2004/2009 may be served under the canonical name at all, or should carry a convention marker (an optional `TLUConvention` column or an attrs record) so Feature('livestock') can warn; (c) add mule/camel factors to _TLU_FACTORS (Jahnke 1982 gives camel 1.0, mule 0.8 under the 250 kg convention) with a source citation.
verify: for (c): tests on transformations.tlu with a camel row; for (a): cold build EthiopiaRHS livestock, tests/test_ethiopiarhs_double_punch.py, coverage regrade of the 1989/1999 cells. CACHE COST: (a)/(b) edit EthiopiaRHS data_scheme.yml / data_info.yml -> EthiopiaRHS re-warm (small country); (c) transformations.py -> none (no transformations symbol reaches a fingerprint, pinned by test_build_transform_hash.py).
contents_org: EthiopiaRHS/_/CONTENTS.org:83-152 'WRONG WAVE: *lvs5.tab / *inc5.tab are 1989 data served at t=1999' (SPSS date stamps 1989-05..1990-04, packed HHID signature, 322/541 overlap with the 1989 roster, zero with R5); 1999/_/data_info.yml:181-186 the recovered IFPRI factor table.
blocked_by: #738's wave adjudication (human); a sourcing decision for cattle 0.70 vs 0.83 vs EPAR's 0.50
decision_for_human: A) relabel the *lvs5 files to t='1989' and build the roster, applying the library's tlu(); or B) keep serving IFPRI's scalar under TLU with an explicit convention marker?

title: Uganda/Ethiopia nutrition.py silently rebuild their FCT from the live USDA API when the un-tracked fct_usda.csv is missing
dedup_status: partial (Uganda's fct_usda.csv IS now git-tracked: `git ls-files Uganda/_` lists it, un-ignored by name in .gitignore:84-92, landed in 8ec0bab4e v0.11.0 -- suggestion 1 done for Uganda; the silent fallback at Uganda/_/nutrition.py:34-39 and the literal API key at :21 remain; Ethiopia is WORSE than the issue states: Ethiopia/_/nutrition.py:31-34 has no CSV and no fallback -- it calls nutrient_df(fct_add, apikey) on EVERY build)
priority_why: Ethiopia nutrition is non-reproducible on every cold build and needs outbound network plus a hardcoded third-party key; a Savio node without egress fails the build outright.
summary: Uganda: nutrition.py:29 reads fct_usda.csv (now tracked), :34-39 still rebuilds from the live API on FileNotFoundError and writes the file; apikey literal at :21. Ethiopia: nutrition.py:31 the same literal key, :33-34 `fct_add = nutrient_df(fct_add, apikey)` unconditionally -- there is no fct_usda.csv in Ethiopia/_ (ls shows fct_tools.py only) -- so Ethiopia's FCT is whatever FDC returns on build day, and the build cannot run offline. The .gitignore comment records the cache-hash consequence: `.csv` in `_/` is a hashed build input, so an untracked generated CSV made two checkouts disagree on all 28 Uganda hashes.
evidence: lsms_library/countries/Uganda/_/nutrition.py:21,29-39; lsms_library/countries/Ethiopia/_/nutrition.py:25-36; git ls-files lsms_library/countries/{Uganda,Ethiopia}/_ | grep fct; .gitignore:84-92; git log -- Uganda/_/fct_usda.csv -> 8ec0bab4e
approach: (1) Ethiopia: run nutrient_df once deliberately (needs egress + key), write Ethiopia/_/fct_usda.csv, track it by name in .gitignore, and make nutrition.py read it; (2) both: replace the FileNotFoundError fallback with a hard error naming a `scripts/refresh_fct.py --country` (opt-in network); (3) move the key to config (`~/.config/lsms_library/config.yml: fdc_api_key`) read via the existing lookup order, and rotate it (human: the literal is in git history). (1)-(2) are code; (3)'s rotation needs a human.
verify: tests/test_uganda_invariance.py (var/fct.parquet, var/nutrition.parquet baselines) must still pass for Uganda; for Ethiopia a cold build with network disabled must succeed; a new test asserting no `nutrient_df(` call is reachable without the flag. CACHE COST: Uganda/Ethiopia `_/nutrition.py` and a new `_/fct_usda.csv` (`.csv` is in _BUILD_INPUT_SUFFIXES) -> full re-warm of BOTH countries' tables (every `_/*.py`/`.csv` is in every wave's binp: hash).
contents_org: n/a for the fallback itself; Ethiopia/_/CONTENTS.org and Uganda/_/CONTENTS.org record the FCT as Tanzania-origin plus FDC additions (nutrition.py:25-27 'foods non-existent in the given Tanzania fct'), which is why the live call exists.
blocked_by: outbound network + a valid FDC key for the one-time Ethiopia materialisation; key rotation (human)
decision_for_human: Rotate the FDC key now (it is a literal in two tracked files and in git history)? yes/no
